title: Operating an Agent-Driven Dataset Factory: Discovery, Construction, and Public Release
abstract: arXiv:2611.21957v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Turning public data into prediction datasets requires connecting source discovery, task definition, construction, and distribution. We deployed Dataset Factory to perform these steps continuously under a standing release policy. Bounded language-model tasks interpret sources, write construction code, and review task meaning; deterministic software manages state, workers, retries, and publication. Over 81.53 hours, the factory published 14 datasets at an estimated recurring operating expenditure of about \$2.74 per publication. The accounting includes failed attempts, inference, workers, and hosting. Separate agents completed prediction experiments on all twelve evaluated releases. Source review nevertheless identified a task whose construction filters contradicted its population declaration. translated_title: 运营一个智能体驱动的数据集工厂：发现、构建与公开发布
translated_abstract: 将公开数据转化为预测数据集，需要把数据源发现、任务定义、构建和分发等环节连接起来。我们部署了 Dataset Factory（数据集工厂），在常设发布政策下持续执行这些步骤。有界的语言模型任务负责解读数据源、编写构建代码并审查任务含义；确定性软件则负责管理状态、工作进程、重试和发布。在81.53小时内，该工厂发布了14个数据集，估计的经常性运营支出约为每次发布2.74美元。该成本核算包含了失败的尝试、推理、工作进程和托管费用。独立的智能体在全部12个被评估的发布版本上完成了预测实验。尽管如此，数据源审查仍然发现了一个任务，其构建过滤器与其总体声明相矛盾。原始审查者接受了后续记录中被排除的条目，却没有将其与已发布的选择规则进行核对。这一经验记录了一次
tldr: 该论文部署了一个由语言模型智能体驱动、确定性软件支撑的自动化“数据集工厂”，在81.53小时内以约2.74美元的单次发布成本持续产出14个预测数据集，并通过审查暴露了构建规则与数据总体声明不一致的治理问题。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates an agent-driven "Dataset Factory" that continuously published 14 prediction datasets over 81.53 hours at an estimated recurring cost of about $2.74 per release, while revealing governance issues where construction filters contradicted declared data populations.
